capabilities: Manage tasks in a single todo.txt file with one list per +project tag
Filter tasks into Today and Upcoming views grouped by due date
Create and edit tasks through a structured modal without typing todo.txt syntax
Add tasks by pasting text, global hotkey, or Obsidian URI links
Reorder and move tasks by drag and drop and fuzzy-search all lists
disambiguation: Not a reminder or notification tool; it is passive by design and surfaces tasks only in the Today view when due, with no OS notifications.
extras: Desktop-only (macOS); distributed as an unpacked dev plugin that must be built and copied into the vault manually; flagged as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; full design in a separate SPEC.md.
problem: Obsidian has no dedicated task manager; tasks scattered across notes as checkboxes get no due dates, priorities, recurrence, or a consolidated day view.
summary: Task manager that stores tasks in a single plain-text todo.txt file, with lists, due dates, priorities, recurrence, and Today/Upcoming views.
